title: Dealer site configuration
description: Brand token VALUES, business facts, SEO defaults and operational linkage for a dealer's static brand site. All site CONTENT lives in the site/ plain files, never here.

channelToken.description: Stable Vendure channel token. Ties the repo, Vercel project and inventory rewrite together.

url.description: Canonical absolute site URL, e.g. https://<channelToken>.buzznerd.com

contractVersion.description: Version of the ai/*.md rulebook this site was built under.

business.description: Business facts. Kept truthful and consistent with visible markup + JSON-LD.

titleTemplate.description: Template applied to non-home page titles, e.g. "%s | Dealer Name".

storefrontOrigin.description: Origin of the Remix inventory storefront for this dealer. Each dealer proxies to their own subdomain: the app identifies the dealer by hostname, so one shared origin cannot serve two.

storefrontPrefix.description: The single URL prefix the storefront is mounted under. Preserved by the proxy, never stripped — Remix mounts routes and client bundles beneath it, so a stripped prefix yields HTML that renders and never hydrates.

analytics.description: Platform analytics. Written by the platform on connect and publish; not dealer-editable. Which third-party providers a dealer has enabled lives in platform/analytics.json, not here — one file per concern, and this one is read by the dealer's own site while that one is regenerated on every publish.

loaderUrl.description: Platform-hosted analytics loader. Tracking logic is never inlined: a fleet-wide change must not require a commit in every dealer repo.

loaderVersion.description: The renderer version this repo is on. Reported by providers that ask for the site technology version. Never hardcoded, or it drifts per dealer the moment a renderer ships.
